evidence.title: Arkon - The Open-Source Enterprise AI Knowledge Hub & MCP Server

name: Arkon
summary: Self-hosted knowledge hub and MCP server that compiles internal docs into a wiki for LLMs.
description: A self-hosted knowledge layer that compiles SOPs, policies and internal documents into a traceable wiki and serves it to Claude and other MCP clients through a single permission-scoped endpoint. Department and global scopes with RBAC, a draft review and version history workflow, PostgreSQL + pgvector search, pluggable AI providers and Docker deployment.
contains: MCP server for Claude and other clients (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE) with wiki, source and draft tools
MRP pipeline compiles documents into interlinked wiki pages with plan review and version history
department and global scopes with fine-grained RBAC and an audit log
full-text + semantic (pgvector) search and a knowledge graph browser
pluggable LLM, embedding and vision providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI)
Docker deployment with 7 containers; sizing for 1–20, 20–100 and 100+ teams
versioned, department-scoped AI skill packages (.zip with SKILL.md)
